what: Redraws the 2D canvas picture (video, text, lines) received as a shader-doodle texture, like a videotape. Horizontal bands jitter with value noise (frequency 15, speed 50, width .002). The bottom 1% of the screen is pushed upward on a sin(t·.1) tempo while its color drifts toward purple. 100 scanlines roll by at 5 lines per second, passing at .9x darkness. R, G, B are layered six times at .001, .003, .002 offsets to bleed, then lowered to .6x. On top go pixel scanlines at half-resolution period (exponent .2), 1.5x brightness, and a 1 to 1.1x brightness band flowing top to bottom. While loading, fx:static 1 turns on random brightness noise (×.2)

options.static: Initial static noise intensity 0 to 1, default 0. The loading entrance screen uses 1. Afterwards change it by sending fx:static (0 to 1) to the element
options.amp: Band sway amount (share of screen width), default .002
options.lines: Number of moving scan lines, default 100
options.[data-fx-part=source]: 2D canvas that draws the picture (required) — left transparent when the shader is up and used only as a texture. Re-uploaded every frame (force-update)

from.where: index.html .jy-tv — original MainShader (shader-doodle shadertoy · sd-texture #unprocessed-canvas force-update · sd-uniform staticStrength = 1 before fully received · 0 after). The shader was rewritten with the same values

note: The original shader code was not ported, it was rewritten with the same steps and same values (the noise hash differs). With reduced motion the shader is not run, so the original canvas shows as is. Since the plane covers the whole screen, the shader plane is pointer-events: none so the DOM below receives cursor and press
